text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Oguri Cap,
we stopped by the shopping street. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Smells so good...
The shopping district at this hour really works up an appetite.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
I'm so hungry...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hey you two, looking all close over there!
Care to give it a try~?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Special-Grade Carrot Hamburg Steak, you say...?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Let us draw... the raffle!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Just once... Yeah, just once is all I need.
Won't you give me a chance?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If nothing comes out on the first try, I'll gracefully give up.
So please... I'm begging you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'll make the most of this chance given to me.
I'm going to bring back that Supreme Carrot Hamburger Steak!
choice_data_list: Hold on, we need to get raffle tickets first!
Wait, we have to get raffle tickets first!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm, raffle tickets?
Where does one acquire those?
choice_data_list: You can get one if you buy something.
You can get one if you buy something.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'll go buy some snacks or something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, I got one lottery ticket.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Alright...!
Let's go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a serious look on her face, Oguri Cap
placed her hand on the raffle drum.
The tension felt almost like being in a pre-race paddock...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—spun it with all their might!
The result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...!
Hot springs trip...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Will this lottery ticket take me on a hot springs trip?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's the grand prize ticket.
Yeah, it's the grand prize ticket.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So that's what it was. All I heard
was "Special Deluxe Carrot Hamburg Steak"...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I'm really happy.
Actually, even happier than having a hamburg steak."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I love hot springs.
Back in my hometown, I often went on tours of hidden hot springs."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I see, so we can go to a hot spring...
choice_data_list: Go invite a friend to come along.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Friends... hmm, tough choice.
A friend I'd want to go to a hot spring with...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, could you hold onto
this ticket for a while?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Either way, we probably can't go right away.
Both I and the others have things we need to do.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Then it's safer for you to hold onto it.
If it were me, I might accidentally toss it in the wash.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So, I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Thinking that made sense, I ended up holding onto the hot spring trip ticket.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...!
Ooooh...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So this is the Special Deluxe Carrot Hamburg Steak...!
What incredible size, what unbelievable thickness...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...*Gulp*.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine.
I'm not going to do something like eat in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So, let's head home quickly.
Before my mouth runs away with me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Afterward, I desperately chased after Oguri Cap,
who was walking far faster than usual,
and somehow managed to enjoy a delicious feast."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm, a mountain of carrots, is it...?
Well, this is quite delightful in its own way!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that hamburg steak...
I really did want to eat it after all...”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If you trace a Carrot Hamburger Steak back to its roots, it's just a carrot.
In other words, these carrots are—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It means it's also a hamburg steak.
Yeah... this could work!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Oguri Cap and I carried a mountain
of carrots back together in great harmony.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...J-Just one...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine.
I remembered...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
When I was young, back in my hometown...
There were times when I was terribly hungry.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "Back then, Shige-san, whom I met on the roadside,gave me a single carrot."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"When I took a bite of that, it tasted far sweeter……
than any carrot I had ever eaten before."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...I feel like... this carrot
will taste just like that, too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Oguri Cap carefully nibble
on a single carrot,
I took my time heading home that day...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...!
Tissues... Just tissues, huh...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...If we boil it,
I wonder if it would be edible...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I desperately consoled Oguri Cap
to keep her from doing anything rash...
